note: WP-55 (wave 9, issue #76) rewrote the About, frameworks, UBF, founders, network, investors, contact, trust and press pages and repositioned /about/facts/ (SITE-COPY 7 and 9, BRIEF.md framework definitions). The sentence map below is the /about/facts/ map, moved here from sources/wp-41.json when the package wording was retired (coordinator direction, WP-54 owns the package data): tests/unit/wp-41/facts.test.ts reads it, fails when a page sentence is unmapped or a locator is missing. The framework definitions on /about/frameworks/ and /about/frameworks/ubf/ are quoted from BRIEF.md (the organization's framework notes) and carry claim C-19 (methods, not standards); the About, founders and contact copy is SITE-COPY 6.0, 7 and 9 verbatim. No fetch was made and no outside statistic is used.
